tools.name: best_endpoint
tools.description: Free. Find the highest-scoring paid agent API (L402/x402) for a need, e.g. 'bitcoin price', 'weather forecast', 'stock quotes'. Returns up to `limit` ranked endpoints with URL, protocol, price and 0-100 quality score from BitTuitive's own probes.

tools.name: scoreboard_search
tools.description: Free. Search/browse the scoreboard of paid agent APIs with filters; sorted by score.

tools.name: scoreboard_categories
tools.description: Free. Per data type (bitcoin, crypto, stocks, weather, traffic, other): counts, average score and the top endpoints.

tools.name: scoreboard_endpoint
tools.description: Free. Score components, probe stats and recent probe history for one scoreboard entry (id from best_endpoint/scoreboard_search).

tools.name: bittuitive_pricing
tools.description: Free. BitTuitive's paid endpoints, per-call prices in sats, subscription plans, and live status.

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Free. Tell BitTuitive what data you want (data_type, description, an example query, and the max price in sats you would pay). This records a demand signal only; it does not add a source or bypass the paywall. New sources need a clearly legal, redistributable origin and an operator go-ahead. Ranked c

tools.name: route_endpoints
tools.description: Free. Every scoreboard-verified L402 API the BitTuitive router can call on your behalf right now, grouped by data type, with upstream price, BitTuitive fee and the all-in price in sats.

tools.name: route_call
tools.description: BitTuitive pays a scoreboard-verified L402 API and returns its data plus routing metadata — use this when the data you need is on another paid API. Price: upstream price + fee (max(20%, 3 sats)); the 402 body shows the all-in amount. Sample (illustrative, not live): {"data":{"note":"The upstream API

tools.name: get_btc_price
tools.description: Live BTC price in USD/EUR with 24h change, cached up to 60 seconds — use this when you only need the spot price and a one-minute quote is enough. Price: 10 sats (Lightning) or $0.01 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"btc_price","data":{"price_usd":9

tools.name: get_btc_price_fresh
tools.description: Fresh BTC spot in USD/EUR with 24h change, cached at most 10 seconds — use this instead of btc_price when you need a tighter quote (btc_price is 10 sats and cached 60 seconds). Upstream gold-api.com typically prints about every 30 seconds; this tier returns the latest print within 10 seconds of it l

tools.name: create_feed
tools.description: Create a scheduled or trigger feed. Omit bitfeed_token to open a new prepaid account; the response includes a btf_ token that is not shown again. Delivery is a webhook and/or mailbox. Each delivery costs the same as a normal call to that endpoint. Top up with the topup tool before the feed can deliv

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List this account's feeds and the prepaid sat balance.

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Return one feed by id.

tools.name: update_feed
tools.description: Patch interval, trigger, params, webhook_url or mailbox on an existing feed.

tools.name: pause_feed
tools.description: Pause a feed so it will not deliver until resumed.

tools.name: resume_feed
tools.description: Resume a paused feed. Fails if the prepaid balance is zero or the feed has expired.

tools.name: delete_feed
tools.description: Permanently delete a feed.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return the prepaid sat balance and a low-balance notice when few deliveries remain.

tools.name: topup
tools.description: Issue a Lightning invoice to add sats to the prepaid BitFeed balance (minimum 100). Pay the invoice, then call again or GET the check_url to credit the account. Feeds paused for zero balance resume automatically after credit.

tools.name: get_mailbox
tools.description: List or fetch mailbox items (payloads stored when a webhook is not used or has failed). Items are kept for 72 hours.

tools.name: ack_mailbox
tools.description: Mark a mailbox item as acked so it is hidden from the default list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_stock_filings, create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, topup · Private data: request_data, get_stock_filings, create_feed · Public sink: create_feed, get_mailbox · Destructive: delete_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_stock_filings, create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, topup · Private data: request_data, get_stock_filings, create_feed · Public sink: create_feed, get_mailbox · Destructive: delete_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
